other_conditions: Must be a permanent resident of Arunachal Pradesh.
Must be employed in building and other construction works.
Must be registered with the Arunachal Pradesh Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APB&OCWWB).
Must have an active membership at the time of application.
Children must be above 18 years for females and above 21 years for males.
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of ₹10,000 will be given to the registered workers for marriage of their children.
